title: Standing rule: iOS simulator work runs on the Neo only
acceptance: AGENTS.md "Two-machine conductors" says iOS simulator building, running and testing for development or verification happens on the Neo only, until the owner changes it; the Air keeps only the CI runner's RitmoFit-CI simulator and runtime; a session on the Air that needs a simulator hands that step to the Neo (or the owner); either conductor still plans, edits and finishes iOS work.

evidence.summary: Owner (Air session, 2026-11-03): "how about we definitely silo iOS simulator dev work to the Neo machine"; then, asked whether it should be a permanent AGENTS.md rule: "Yes, make it a permanent AGENTS.md rule until I decide to change it. It's just easier, more steamlined. and I can clear space on this machine" (recorded on this PR).

resolution: AGENTS.md gains the "iOS simulator work runs on the Neo" bullet under Two-machine conductors.
